comparison.objective: Diagnose and remove a hidden bore obstruction before seating a peg, not tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Detects an early stop, backs out, tips out a ball, realigns, and reinserts without exceeding force limits.
comparison.success_condition: Ball removed and peg head within 3 mm of the face, with zero credit after force above 3 N or a fall, versus two tuned carriage stops after relocking.
comparison.reason: Both require reacting safely to physical response, but obstruction diagnosis and disassembly/reinsertion test a different ability from parameter calibration.
